notes.title: Abandoned?
notes.notes:
Hi,

First, THANK YOU for reading! 😊
If you're reading this, it means you like WASD Quartet and are curious to know more about the game ;)

Is it still in development? Is it abandoned?

IT IS NOT ABANDONED!

The reason there hasn't been any news is that I want to finish one project before starting another.
My first game, Spikair Volleyball, is still in Early Access, and I'd like to complete it before moving on to WASD Quartet ;)

If you want to know more about my other games, you can find them here:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ChocAbyss


Otherwise, you'll have to wait a bit longer, and I hope you'll be happy when the game is released. Just a heads-up: I keep jotting down ideas for this game, but it will be a short game with limited content :3

My goal is to create a small journey, and if, at the end, you feel something, I'll be really happy. ♥

notes.title: Demo available
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I polished the build from the Game Jam and decided to share it here.
This way, you'll be able to try the gameplay of WASD Quartet and see if you're interested by a bigger adventure :)

Thank you for reading and hope you'll like the demo :D

P-S : Feel free to give feedbacks on the Steam forum ♥
